'''Special Edition''' is the 18th expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher in November 1998. It is 324 cards (162 Light Side and 162 Dark Side): 120 rares, 80 uncommons, 80 commons, and 44 fixed cards (starter-only). Black border. CardGuide numbering: 18th product.

It is the largest set since Premiere and overhauled the rules (comprehensive rulebook and glossary). Debuts include [[Objective]]s, [[Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith]], and new starter decks that contain the 44 fixed cards. Sold in 9-card packs (MSRP $2.50) in 30-pack boxes, and in 60-card starter decks (MSRP $12.95; 12 decks per box, 6 per side).<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Special_Edition_Limited Special Edition Limited] at Wookieepedia</ref>

== Packaging ==
Booster packs mix 5 commons, 3 uncommons, and 1 rare. Starter decks are 22 fixed + 22 commons + 14 uncommons + 2 rares, plus a rule book and glossary.<ref name="encyc" />

== Memorabilia ==
Decipher issued a four-panel poster (~32&Prime; &times; 10.5&Prime;) for every expansion from Premiere through Death Star II. Special Edition's reverse is the expansion card list.<ref name="encyc" />

[[File:SE-Limited-four-panel-poster.png|360px|Special Edition four-panel poster front]]
[[File:SE-Limited-four-panel-poster-back.png|360px|Special Edition four-panel poster reverse]]

''Front and reverse (Light Side / Dark Side card list)''

== Print sheets ==
Rares and uncommons are 11&times;11 (121 cards): 60 rares twice per sheet with one blank slot; 40 uncommons three times per sheet with one blank slot. Fixed cards are 11&times;10 (110 cards): 22 titles five times per sheet.<ref name="encyc" />
